fields.objection: The 037b 3.410 MPa cold face compression is represented only by a separate strength-debit screen; its residual shape and geometric stiffness are not solved.
fields.proposed_fix: Couple measured cure/relaxation behavior, effective core membrane stiffness and shell prestress; preserve self-equilibrium.
